steps.name: bootstrap-test-environment
steps.run:
set -Eeuo pipefail
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq --no-install-recommends ca-certificates git nodejs python3-pip python3-venv >/tmp/apt-install.log 2>&1
python3 -m venv .venv
. .venv/bin/activate
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet --upgrade pip setuptools wheel
python -m pip install --disable-pip-version-check --quiet -r requirements-dev.txt playwright==1.55.0
python -m pip check
if ! python -m playwright install --with-deps chromium >/tmp/playwright-install.log 2>&1; then
  tail -n 200 /tmp/playwright-install.log
  exit 1
fi
python --version
python -c "import PIL; print('Pillow', PIL.__version__)"
node --version
ruff --version
pytest --version

steps.name: rerun-readable-diagram-real-vi-regression
steps.run:
set -Eeuo pipefail
. .venv/bin/activate
export PYTHONUNBUFFERED=1
export BUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR="$PWD/artifacts/readable-diagram-density"
export WORK_ROOT="$PWD/.sandbox-pytest-jobs"
rm -rf "$BUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR" "$WORK_ROOT"
mkdir -p "$BUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR" "$WORK_ROOT"
LOG="$BUILD_ARTIFACT_DIR/full-validation.log"
set +e
bash scripts/sandbox_readable_diagram_test.sh >"$LOG" 2>&1
status=$?
set -e
grep -v '^READABLE_CONTACT_SHEET_B64_' "$LOG" | tail -n 260 || true
exit "$status"

steps.name: render-small-evidence-previews
steps.run:
set -Eeuo pipefail
. .venv/bin/activate
SRC="$PWD/artifacts/readable-diagram-density"
OUT="$PWD/.local_relay/output"
rm -rf "$OUT"
mkdir -p "$OUT"
python - <<'PY'
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
from PIL import Image

SRC = Path('artifacts/readable-diagram-density')
OUT = Path('.local_relay/output')


def save_under(source: str, target: str, *, crop=None, bounds=(720, 450), max_bytes=12000) -> dict[str, object]:
    image = Image.open(SRC / source).convert('RGB')
    if crop is not None:
        width, height = image.size
        left, top, right, bottom = crop
        image = image.crop((int(width * left), int(height * top), int(width * right), int(height * bottom)))
    image.thumbnail(bounds, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    path = OUT / target
    quality = 48
    while True:
        image.save(path, 'JPEG', quality=quality, optimize=True, progressive=True, subsampling=2)
        if path.stat().st_size <= max_bytes:
            break
        if quality > 22:
            quality -= 6
            continue
        new_size = (max(320, int(image.width * 0.88)), max(220, int(image.height * 0.88)))
        if new_size == image.size:
            break
        image = image.resize(new_size, Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
    data = path.read_bytes()
    return {
        'path': target,
        'width': image.width,
        'height': image.height,
        'bytes': len(data),
        'sha256': hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest(),
        'quality': quality,
    }

entries = [
    save_under('real-readability-1440x900.png', 'preview-real-full.jpg', bounds=(720, 450), max_bytes=12000),
    save_under(
        'real-readability-1440x900.png',
        'preview-real-canvas.jpg',
        crop=(0.25, 0.12, 0.90, 0.98),
        bounds=(900, 720),
        max_bytes=18000,
    ),
    save_under('readable-diagram-contact-sheet.jpg', 'preview-contact.jpg', bounds=(900, 500), max_bytes=15000),
    save_under('readable-basic-1440x900.png', 'preview-basic.jpg', bounds=(720, 450), max_bytes=12000),
    save_under('readable-flow-1440x900.png', 'preview-flow.jpg', bounds=(720, 450), max_bytes=12000),
    save_under('readable-huge-overview-1440x900.png', 'preview-huge.jpg', bounds=(720, 450), max_bytes=12000),
]
(OUT / 'preview-manifest.json').write_text(json.dumps({'files': entries}, indent=2) + '\n', encoding='utf-8')
print(json.dumps({'files': entries}, separators=(',', ':')))
PY
find "$OUT" -maxdepth 1 -type f -printf '%f %s bytes\n' | sort
